purpose: Root integration fixtures for the canonical atomic variant writer, never a seed or live merchant catalog.
identity: Creation commands contain no ID. Readback and edit must use the durable UUID returned by canonical persistence. No SKU correlation, guessed UUID or second save.
expectations: Inherited edition has 15 complete items, common tray/tile measurements, age and warning; only finish changes.
Unknown edition has no ageStatement, no ageBands, no contents, contentsComplete false, dimensions null, no additional measurements or warnings.
Paper edition has 36 sheets, one A5 measurement, no inherited tray height/tile measurements, no old prose ageStatement, and no warning from another edition.
Changing selected variants updates the displayed accepted facts and server cart/order snapshot; prior selection never leaks.
A bad variant payload rejects the atomic mutation; parent/variants/outbox remain unchanged. Cross-tenant facts never read or mutate.
